entries.german: Anna Marschalkein des Chuntz von Rosenberch Wittwe verpflichtet sich, dem Karthäuser Kloster zu Tükelhusen zur Begehung des Jahrtages für ihren seligen Hauswirth jährlich 4 Malter Korns aus einem Hofe zu Ewrheusen zu entrichten. Mitsiegler: Cuntz von Rosenberch obiger Anna Sohn, Hans von Rosenberch Ritter, und Arnolt von Rosenberch der junge gesessen zu Boxsperch. G. am freitag vor Liechtmesse. (c. 3 Sig.)
entries.english: Anna Marschalkein, widow of Kunz von Rosenberg, undertakes to pay the Carthusian monastery at Tükelhusen four Malter of grain annually from a farm at Ewrheusen for the observance of the anniversary of her late husband. Co-sealers: Kunz von Rosenberg, Anna’s son; Hans von Rosenberg, Ritter; and Arnold von Rosenberg der Junge, resident at Boxberg. Given on the Friday before Candlemas. (With three seals.)

facts.content: undertook to pay an annual grain rent from a farm at Ewrheusen to the Carthusian monastery at Tükelhusen for the anniversary of her late husband Kunz von Rosenberg.
co-sealed his mother Anna Marschalkein’s charter for the Carthusian monastery at Tükelhusen.
